name: sunny-pastures
description: Cosy farm and bakery idle game with a deterministic simulation shared by client and server.

scripts.supabase:check: v=$(supabase --version 2>/dev/null); [ "$v" = 2.122.0 ] || { echo "Supabase CLI 2.122.0 required, found: ${v:-none}" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:fast: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:changed && pnpm format:check && pnpm guard:floor && pnpm boundaries
scripts.check:task: pnpm check:fast && pnpm lint && pnpm format:md && pnpm dupes --changed-since origin/main && node .github/scripts/sim-changed.mjs SIM_PROPERTY_RUNS=1000 -- pnpm test:related && pnpm coverage:gate --skip-ratchet && pnpm determinism
scripts.check:full: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm format:md && pnpm dupes --changed-since origin/main && pnpm guard:floor && pnpm boundaries && SIM_PROPERTY_RUNS=1000 pnpm test && pnpm coverage:gate && pnpm determinism
